title: core.phys.bounds — axis-aligned box and true minimal sphere
description: The whole-entity bounds and, optionally, per-part bounds. The sphere is the TRUE minimal enclosing sphere (Welzl), not the sphere circumscribing the AABB — the two differ by up to 73% in volume and a culling system that assumes the wrong one is either wrong or wasteful. Which one it is, is therefore declared.

space.description: Entity bounds are in model space (before any instance transform). Per-part bounds are in that part's local space; each entry says so again.

aabb_max.description: metres, component-wise maximum; each component >= the corresponding aabb_min

sphere_method.description: How the sphere was computed. 'welzl-exact' is the true minimal sphere and what an enrichment pipeline MUST produce. The other two are recorded honestly when that is what a source provided.

volume_m3.description: Enclosed volume of the closed surface. 0 when the mesh is not closed; use 'watertight' to tell those cases apart.

watertight.description: Whether the source surface is closed and manifold. A volume from a non-watertight mesh is a fiction and this flag is how a consumer knows.
